title: Gallery: Album & Photo Vault
summary: Photo Gallery manages photos, videos, albums and keeps them safe using the vault
description:
Gallery: Album & Photo Vault is a fast, clean, and smart Photos app to manage all your photos and videos. Easily organize, protect, and relive your favorite moments with a secure photo vault and advanced gallery tools. Designed for smooth performance, this photo gallery gives you a premium, private viewing experience across any device.

Use this powerful Photos app to explore your memories, create albums, and hide private media in a secure vault. Whether you want to sort files, set wallpapers, or play HD videos, our Gallery offers an intuitive experience for every Android user.

Key Features:

Photos & Videos – View, sort, and manage all your images and video clips in one simple HD gallery app.
Secure Vault Lock – Hide private photos and videos behind fingerprint or PIN protection.
Easy Wallpaper Setup – Instantly set your favorite gallery photos as wallpapers.
High-Quality Video Player – Enjoy smooth video playback support.
Slideshow Mode – Relive your memories with auto photo slideshows.
Photo Editor – Edit photo with filters, stickers, text, blur, crop, and frames.
Favorites Manager – Bookmark memorable photos and videos for quick access anytime.
Deleted File Recovery – Restore deleted files easily with the built-in recycle bin.
Rename, Copy & Move Media – Organize your collection and keep your gallery neat.
Detailed Info View – Access metadata like resolution, file size, and creation date.
Multilingual Interface – Enjoy the app in your native language with full localization.
Dark Mode & Themes – Personalize your interface dark & light theme.
Ad-Free Premium Version – Unlock advanced features and enjoy an ad-free viewing experience.
After Call Shortcut – Quickly access gallery tools right after ending a call.

Gallery: Album & Photo Vault helps you keep your digital life organized and private. You can easily find photos, recover deleted ones, and manage albums all while protecting your memories with secure vault lock technology.
